parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Page number, greater than 0 and not exceeding the maximum value of Integer. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
Number of records per page, with the following options:
- **30** - **50** - **100**
Default value: 30.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-streaming-jobs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-bp10g78o9807yv9h3 --page-size 1 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
